name: gi-company-formation
description: Gibraltar private company formation reference covering subscribers, constitution, capital disclosures, registered office, director and secretary requirements, compliance declarations and incorporation fees. Includes core corporate beneficial-ownership duties and the September 2026 registrar transition; historical nominee/appointor cases, sector permissions and submission verification remain open; this source-cited draft is not professionally attested. Use for 2026 private-company incorporation preparation, capital allocation and beneficial-owner evidence gathering.
